# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 113 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 113 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_113_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10 — The Final Commission

**1** "Do you understand all of this now?" he asked me. "Yes, Lord," I said. "I understand everything you've told me." **2** "But there are things beyond what I've shared," he said. "There's much more you still need. I haven't told you everything yet. But listen carefully now. **3** Carry out and keep everything you've been commanded. And the things you've heard from the Church — obey those too. **4** Tell the leaders of the Church to live and lead in righteousness, so that they can attain complete righteousness and be cleansed and purified through the seal of the Son of God. **5** Because this seal is the truth — everyone who bears it will enter God's kingdom. **6** Don't be lazy about the Lord's work. **7** Hermas — you are to pass all these words on to the elders of the Church. And let this message be proclaimed to the whole world. **8** Tell every church leader to walk the path of righteousness completely, **9** so that salvation and forgiveness of sins may come to them through the name of the Son of God. Through that great and glorious name, they will be made glorious." **10** Then the Shepherd left me. And after him, the Glorious One departed.

---

*PNEUMA renders the final commission with directness and urgency — the mandate to proclaim repentance to church leaders throughout the whole world is the Shepherd's final word.*
